data.long_description:
Provident Real Estate proudly presents this luxuriously upgraded and fully furnished 2-bedroom apartment in Shams 2, Jumeirah Beach Residence (JBR) - one of Dubai’s most desirable beachfront destinations.

Featuring 1,323.42 sq. ft., this elegant high-floor residence offers breathtaking Sea and Marina views, modern finishes, and bright interiors. Designed for both comfort and style, it’s ready for you to move in and start enjoying the coastal lifestyle.

Property Highlights:
* 2 Spacious Bedrooms | 2 Bathrooms
* Fully Furnished & Ready to Move In
* High Floor | Sea & Marina Views
* 1 Allocated Covered Parking Space

Amenities:
* Outdoor Swimming Pool & Modern Gym
* BBQ Area for Residents
* Valet Parking & 24/7 Security
* Direct Access to JBR Beach, The Walk & Bluewaters

About the Community:
Jumeirah Beach Residence is an iconic waterfront development that continues to hold strong value due to its prime location and unmatched lifestyle appeal. Chosen by both investors and end-users, JBR is an adress that is known all over the world, it’s already a landmark destination recognized instantly by anyone passing through Dubai Marina.
